description:
## Problem
No BenchBox path runs the specification's historical load, and nothing can fail a TPC-DI run on wrong answers.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- Milestone: "every audit test that can be evaluated after Batch 1 returns OK. The excluded tests are listed by name in that pull request, each with the reason, and you approve the list at the stop."
- Parsing: "Allow third-party engine extensions for XML."
- Phases: "generate = produce source files; load = initialization (schema and reference data, untimed); power = historical load, both incremental updates and the untimed audit."
- Timing: "Compute the metric from the monotonic clock; also record the DImessages timestamps as audit evidence; disclose the difference in the documentation."
- "A run whose audit fails is marked non-clean and cannot be published or ranked."

## Change
Plan S9. New benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl_sql/ (staging DDL and the Clause 4.5 transformations in dependency order, including type-2 history, DImessages alerts, Prospect, Financial and FINWIRE handling) and phases.py (initialization, batch validation, historical load timed with mono_time, untimed load of the Batch 1 audit files, tpcdi_audit.sql with result rows parsed). Status rule: FAILED if any applicable audit test is not OK; otherwise NOT_VALIDATED, because the workload is incomplete. The CLI gate stays closed.

## Clean-room rule (owner: "Strict clean room: the implementer reads only the specification, the paper and the TPC appendix SQL.")
The implementer reads only the TPC-DI v1.1.0 specification, the VLDB 2014 paper (Poess, Rabl, Jacobsen, Caufield) and the TPC appendix SQL. It never opens PDGF configuration or dictionaries, DIGen or PDGF source or decompiled classes, the `tpc-di_src.jar` plugin source, or `shannon-barrow/databricks-tpc-di`'s `tpcdi_gen`. Subagents get the same rule in their brief. The pull request description states that the rule was followed.

## Decision gates
The DuckDB XML extension used (name, source, version) is named in the pull request description and recorded in the result; if no extension parses CustomerMgmt.xml correctly, stop and ask (client-side parsing was not chosen). The list of audit tests excluded as not evaluable after Batch 1 is produced with a reason per test and is NOT self-approved: it goes to the owner at the stop. Any modification of the audit SQL beyond permitted substitutions stops the item.

## Verification rubric
Pass: through `make heavy-run`, the slow integration test at scale 3 on generated data shows every applicable audit test OK and the excluded set equal to the listed one; negative controls each fail the run and `publish_admission` refuses: one DimTrade.Type set to 'Bogus' (the 'DimTrade Type' test fails), one source row dropped before load, one injected error not alerted; a run with the audit step skipped is NOT_VALIDATED, never PASSED; evidence kept under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs and summarized in the pull request (audit rows, DImessages extract, generator report SHA-256, timings); `make pr-preflight` passes.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
